cases.name: senta-deployment-cert:valid
cases.description: A valid senta-deployment-cert signed by vendor-release-1.

cases.name: senta-deployment-cert:alg_not_eddsa
cases.description: The header's alg is ES256, not EdDSA.

cases.name: senta-deployment-cert:typ_mismatch
cases.description: The header's typ is senta-install-config, not the expected senta-deployment-cert.

cases.name: senta-deployment-cert:crit_header
cases.description: The header carries crit.

cases.name: senta-deployment-cert:unknown_header_member
cases.description: The header carries a member other than alg, typ and kid.

cases.name: senta-deployment-cert:unknown_content_field
cases.description: The content carries a field its schema does not define.

cases.name: senta-deployment-cert:missing_content_field
cases.description: The content lacks its required field install_id.

cases.name: senta-deployment-cert:duplicate_content_key
cases.description: The content writes its field install_id twice.

cases.name: senta-deployment-cert:signature_bit_flipped
cases.description: The valid document with the lowest bit of the first signature byte flipped.

cases.name: senta-deployment-cert:json_serialization
cases.description: The valid document in the flattened JWS JSON serialization.

cases.name: senta-deployment-cert:wrong_key_class
cases.description: Signed by endpoint-0f8fad5b-d9cb-469f-a165-70867728950e:1, a kind of key senta-deployment-cert does not allow.
